data.summary: The Hauptzollamt Beispielhafen set the vehicle tax (Kraftfahrzeugsteuer) for the vehicle with licence plate MS-JB 2604 at €146.00 per year, starting from its registration on 2 November 2026. The amount will be debited automatically from the account on file.
data.explanation: This is an official tax assessment (Steuerbescheid) for the annual vehicle tax on the car registered on 2 November 2026. The tax of €146.00 per year will be collected automatically by direct debit, so no separate payment action is normally needed. If you disagree with the amount or basis of the assessment, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Hauptzollamt — the app shows until when, based on the date this letter is considered delivered. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final and the tax continues to be charged yearly.
